description.subtitle: Italy 2026 adidas pre-match warm-up shirt - white
description.tagline: The elegance of Italy before the match
description.intro: The adidas Italia Pre-Match 2026 Jersey captures the essence of Italian football with a sophisticated design inspired by the country's tradition and style. Its exclusive print evokes the classic elegance that characterizes the Azzurra, combining history and modernity in a unique garment.
key_benefits: Climacool Technology: Keeps skin cool and dry during activity.
Breathable fabric: Promotes ventilation and comfort at all times.
Official design: Inspired by the Italian national team for an authentic style.
Light and comfortable: Perfect for training or daily use.
